title: Lucky
body:
I named my bird Lucky and I am so happy I downloaded this app.
He made me realize lots of stuff plus made my anxiety go away by being there for me and making me do all these tasks to motivate me for the day.
I’m grateful!
For whoever made that app, I honestly love you.
author: hohihihahahgsaja

body: I downloaded it as a joke, but it actually helps. I’m getting stuff done and I don’t have to force myself to do it, I’m writing more about how I feel, I can stop a panic attack before it gets to a scary level, and I have a cute penguin as my friend. Definitely worth a try.
